page.layout: One text block of running Latin in one column. Notes in the right margin beside lines 6 and 12 (Hebr. 11., Ioan. 4.). Left margin holds only show-through and the edge of the neighbouring page, which are omitted. Top right has a handwritten figure, omitted. Foot: signature at left, catchword at right.

main_text.l: tum malum nos circumsideat opprimatque,
nisi ad Deum contendamus: quanta bonorum
innumerabilium in Deo suauitas: quanta in
Ecclesia claritas: quanta in communione
sanctorum delectatio, mutuis celeusmatis inter se
adhortantium: quanta vis maximæ illius nubis
testium (vt Apostolus ad Hebræos vocat) nos
velut circumsonantis clamore sanctissimo in
cælo & terra, vt præeuntes sequamur & obse-
quamur Domino. Hæc cogitatione armati fu-
giamus nosipsos & mala nostra, ad Deum trans-
fugiamus per Ecclesiam eius, & alij alios a-
d participationem admirabilis eiusdem lucis r-
eligione & charitate vera provocemus. Hæc
illa est sanctorum actio, quam Deus imperat,
quam Dauid prædicat, quam pius quisque
diuinam iudicat, & quam nemo nisi impius, si vi-
derit aut modo aliquo senserit, abdicaturus est.
Sed hanc actionem animus non corpus, mens
non manus præstare potest; quandoquidem
(vt docebat Christus) Deus est Spiritus, & eos
qui ipsum adoraturi sunt, in spiritu & veritate
præcipit adorare. Det nobis idem qui præci-
pit, vt corpore, & animo, & spiritu ita comparati,
à nobis ad ipsum in Ecclesia fugiamus in-
definenter, & alij alios secundum illam charit-
atem Christi adiuuemus in persequenda perci-
piendaque illa communicatione gratiæ, incre-
dibilem lætitiam, fructum spiritus suauissi-
mum, in nobis edicturam.

page.notes: The asterisk-like mark after "Domino" in the first paragraph is a printed symbol, read as Domino with a mark; treated as a printing ornament, not a reference. Handwritten figure at top right and the edge of the neighbouring page on the left are not transcribed. Catchword and signature read from the foot of the page; the catchword is the printed "2. Qvod" including its section number.
